en.headline: Fire Services say cigarette butts likely caused Tuen Mun scaffolding blaze
en.dek: Preliminary investigation found multiple cigarette butts on the scaffolding and rooftop, with the fire starting from a third-floor platform at the industrial building.
body: The Fire Services Department said a preliminary investigation into Saturday’s scaffolding fire at an industrial building in Tuen Mun indicated the cause was related to cigarette butts and was not suspicious.

Officers confirmed the fire began on the third-floor exterior platform of the building on Kin Fat Lane and spread upward. Debris and cigarette packets were found on the platform, and multiple cigarette butts were located on the scaffolding and rooftop. Maintenance works that day did not involve open-flame tools.

The fire was reported at about 2.05pm and extinguished by around 2.40pm. About 200 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported. A multi-department investigation group has been set up, including the Buildings Department, the Labour Department and the Government Laboratory.

The Buildings Department said it had issued a stop-work order to the registered contractor after inspection and found no obvious structural danger to the building. Earlier spot checks in July and October had not revealed clear violations.

zh.headline: 消防初步相信煙頭導致屯門工廈棚架火警
zh.dek: 初步調查發現棚架及天台有多個煙頭，火警由三樓平台由下而上蔓延，當日工程並無使用明火工具。
body: 消防處表示，經初步調查後，相信周六屯門工廈外牆棚架火警原因與煙頭有關，並無可疑。
處方確認起火位置為建旺街利通工業大廈外牆三樓平台，火勢由下而上蔓延。平台上發現焚毀雜物及煙包，天台及外牆棚架多處亦見煙頭。當日維修工程並不牽涉使用明火工具。
火警於下午約2時05分接報，約2時40分救熄，現場疏散約200人，暫無受傷報告。消防處已牽頭成立跨部門調查組，成員包括屋宇署、勞工處及政府化驗所。
屋宇署表示經視察後認為樓宇結構沒有明顯危險，已向註冊承建商發出停工令。署方早前於7月及10月突擊視察時未發現明顯違規。
